verdict.rationale: The pack documents org-wide recording, access and retention policies, including zero-day retention, plus Super Admin deletion of workspace data. None of it states whether meeting data is used to train AI models, offers an org-level training opt-out, or cites SOC 2 or HIPAA posture. The generic "enterprise-grade security" claim does not cover the story's actual elements, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
